name: @composable-os/pack-jobs
description: Jobs: jobs and projects for a trades or services business, moving through pipelines of stages whose facts the host keeps (accepted, signed off, invoiced); sites, visits booked with a crew (each crew member's place a shift on the roster), lines of what is quoted, added and used, variations approved by the office, charge-out rates and a CSV of what is unbilled (stage 39). Installed in every deployment of a product that lists it. Bundled as source into cos-runner.

composableOs.label: Jobs
composableOs.description: Jobs and projects from first call to invoice: a board of stages, sites, visits booked with a crew who are never in two places at once, materials and extra work recorded on site, and a download of what is owed.
